name: synth
description: SYNTH — Synthetic Neural & Tool Hub: универсальный чат-клиент для любого OpenAI-совместимого API (поиск, чтение страниц, картинки, долговременная память)

scripts.checks: tsc -p tsconfig.checks.json --noEmit && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.checks.json checks/features.check.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.checks.json checks/memory.check.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.checks.json checks/calculator.check.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.checks.json checks/context.check.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.checks.json checks/anthropic.check.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.checks.json checks/vision.check.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.checks.json checks/share.check.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.checks.json checks/stream.check.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.checks.json checks/db.check.ts
scripts.brand: npm run icons && npm run android:assets
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:install: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug
